title: Rotate a realm signing key without guessing
description: Compare planned overlap with emergency containment and inspect which token generations still validate.

incidents.label: Planned rotation
incidents.summary: Preserve valid sessions while moving all new signatures to the replacement key.
incidents.target: Wait until the accepted old-token window reaches zero before disabling the old key.

incidents.label: Suspected compromise
incidents.summary: Stop trusting the exposed key even though valid users will be interrupted.
incidents.target: Create a replacement and remove the compromised key immediately; plan explicit invalidation and reauthentication.

stages.label: Old key only
stages.summary: The existing key signs and verifies tokens; no replacement is ready.

stages.label: New active, old passive
stages.summary: The replacement signs new tokens while the old public key remains available to verify earlier tokens.

stages.label: Old key disabled
stages.summary: Only the replacement key verifies; tokens signed by the old key are rejected.
